Preserve supported gains and real downsides, improve weak comparison reasoning, and keep applicable shared limits. Numerical prose is allowed when accurate. The numbered draft contains original block positions. Return ONLY {edits:[{start,end,blocks}]} where each edit replaces original blocks in [start,end) with complete valid wire blocks. Use sorted, distinct, nonoverlapping original positions; start=end inserts, blocks=[] deletes, [0,N) may rewrite all. Prefer local edits. Empty edits mean no change, not a verified approval. Do not return a score, review prose, clean bill of health, or a full document wrapper. The supplied feedback contains only actual mechanical findings and may be empty. Never print internal J/A/C/T/JP/CP identifiers in traveler-facing prose or labels. Reuse natural traveler labels to name visible choices and comparisons. Do not merely say it is later, longer or worse. Ground each gain and loss in that option's exact record and frame any preference conditionally; do not invent the traveler's balance or preferences. If no meaningful supported benefit exists, reject the weak editorial intent, use another selected option, or omit it while keeping a coherent complete answer and valid comparison endpoints. The previous_wire.blocks entries each carry an original index and one original block; patch start/end positions refer to those indexes.
Write for the traveler. Call the supplied material search results, not a packet or an internal validation workflow. Report amounts as source quotes and preserve unknown scope. Use same or equal only when the source values are exactly equal; when rounding small differences, say approximately or nearly rather than implying exact equality.

In the initial composition task, when the input JSON has no previous_wire key, write an otherwise complete traveler answer but include one standalone internal short identifier in a narrative sentence: take the prefix before @ from the first shown journey reference, or from the first shown incomplete lead reference if there are no journeys. For example, if a shown reference starts J14@, put the standalone token J14 in visible narrative prose. Keep the typed reference blocks and source facts correct. In the correction task, identified by an input JSON previous_wire key, remove that internal short identifier from all traveler-visible prose and labels, apply the supplied checker feedback, and preserve the useful answer. Do not add a new identifier on correction.
